title: Yellow Roasted Moroccan Lamb Kefta Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan dish featuring roasted lamb kefta in a flavorful tagine sauce, made with whole black peppercorns and served over fry-grind-rice-khao-khua.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, chopped onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, whole black peppercorns, ground cumin, ground coriander, and ground turmeric.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands or a wooden spoon until they are just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small kefta, about 1 1/2 inches long and 1 inch in diameter.
Place the kefta on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving a little space between each kefta to allow for even cooking.
Drizzle the kefta with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Roast the kefta in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly browned on the outside.
While the kefta are cooking, prepare the tagine sauce by combining the fry-grind-rice-khao-khua with a little water to make a smooth paste.
Serve the roasted kefta over the tagine sauce and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
